data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to offer this impressive two-bedroom apartment for rent, situated in the renowned Damac Towers by Paramount Hotels & Resorts Dubai, a landmark residential address in Business Bay.


  Positioned on a high floor, this beautifully maintained corner unit enjoys abundant natural light and stunning panoramic views of the city skyline and surrounding waterfront. The apartment comes fully furnished, is currently vacant, and ready for immediate occupancy, making it an ideal choice for both families and individuals.

  ⦁ 2 Generously Sized Bedrooms
  ⦁ Fully Furnished

  ⦁ High-Floor Unit
  ⦁ Corner Layout
  ⦁ Well-Maintained Condition
  ⦁ Bright Interiors with Large Windows
  ⦁ Premium Open Views


  Spectacular Views Include:


  ⦁ Dubai Creek Harbour
  ⦁ Dubai Design District (d3)
  ⦁ Dubai Water Canal
  ⦁ Community Swimming Pool

  Building & Community Amenities:


  ⦁ Luxury serviced residential towers
  ⦁ Swimming pool and fully equipped gym

  ⦁ Variety of restaurants and cafés
  ⦁ 24/7 security and concierge services

  Prime Location:


  Ideally located in Business Bay, the development offers seamless access to major roads and key destinations across Dubai, ensuring convenience and connectivity at all times including just 10 minutes to Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa.
